svg.font-family: system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: K — Minimal geometric · Thrills & Chills round-3 art concept
svg.text: Five colours, three planes of light each. No outlines, no
texture, no gradients: big simple solids, flat hard shadows,
capsule guests and a lot of empty space. Calm and premium.

g.text: Shadows: one slate plane at 20%, cast by height.
Every ride is boxes, cylinders and cones only.
~1 fill per face: the cheapest sheet to draw.
